hints.title: Component Count Relationship
hints.text: Removing at most k edges divides a connected network of n nodes into at most k plus one components.

hints.title: Kruskal Minimal Spanning Forest
hints.text: To minimize the maximum edge weight retained within components, greedily add the lightest edges first.

hints.title: Early Termination Condition
hints.text: Halt edge insertion as soon as the total component count reduces to k plus one.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: K: number of edge removals allowed
complexity.notes: Sorting edges and Kruskal clustering until k + 1 components remain.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subsets of k edge deletions combinatorially explodes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint set union tracks cluster reductions with minimal scalar memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that removing k edges leaves k + 1 clusters in a minimum spanning forest.
